Getting StartedStart here

Exama is your all-in-one classroom: exams, study material, syllabus, targets, fitness, an AI mentor and a coin wallet.

How to use
  1. Log in with your registered mobile number.
  2. Your dashboard shows quick tiles for every tool. Tap a tile to open it.
  3. Tap the back arrow on any screen to return.
  4. Use the side menu for profile, settings, password and SOS.
Pull down on the dashboard to refresh. It is switched off while a popup or the time picker is open.
NOVA MentorAI Coach

NOVA is your personal AI mentor. It knows your exams, syllabus progress, study hours, fitness and wallet, so its advice is about you.

How to use
  1. Open NOVA from the dashboard.
  2. Type a question or tap a quick prompt such as "Plan my week".
  3. Ask for a study plan, doubt help, or why your score dropped.
  4. Open an exam result and tap NOVA Analysis to see mistakes explained.
In Goal Planner, tap NOVA to get a daily or weekly action plan built from your targets.
CBT ExamsTests

Take computer-based exams assigned by your teacher, then see score, rank and answer review.

How to use
  1. Open Exams and pick an exam. Scheduled exams open at their set time; anytime exams open whenever you like.
  2. If the exam asks for a passkey, enter the one your teacher gave you.
  3. Answer, then submit before the timer ends.
  4. Open Results to see marks, pass or fail, and review each answer.
A missed scheduled exam counts as Absent, which lowers your score average and costs wallet coins.
Math WorkoutSpeed

Short calculation drills that build speed and accuracy.

How to use
  1. Open Math Workout and choose a topic and level.
  2. Type answers with the keyboard. The timer keeps running.
  3. Finish the set to see your score and speed.
Practise a few minutes daily. Speed comes from repetition.
Material HubNotes + Quiz

All study material in one place, sorted by subject and chapter, with auto-generated quizzes.

How to use
  1. Open Study Material and pick a subject, then a chapter.
  2. Open a note to read it.
  3. Use the auto-quiz on a note to test yourself.
Quiz results you generate yourself also count in your analytics.
Focus SessionsStudy timer

A study timer that logs your focused hours. Full 4-hour sessions earn wallet coins.

How to use
  1. Open Focus and start a session.
  2. Keep the screen on and stay focused. Your hours are recorded.
  3. End the session to save it.
Weekly and total study hours feed the Focus leaderboard.
Weekly TargetsTasks

Weekly tasks from your teacher. Tick them off as you finish. You can add your own tasks too.

How to use
  1. Open Weekly Targets. Use the arrows or the calendar to change week.
  2. Tap a task to mark it done. Tap again to undo.
  3. Tap the + at the top right to add your own target. Only you can see it.
  4. Delete your own targets with the bin icon.
The ring shows your completion %. Total, Done and Left show real counts.
Syllabus TrackerCourse

Track every topic through three steps: Class, Revision and Practice.

How to use
  1. Open Syllabus Tracker and pick a subject tab.
  2. Tap Class when the class is done.
  3. Tap Revision or Practice each time you revise or practise. Tap the minus to remove one.
  4. A topic becomes Mastered when Class, Revision and Practice are all done.
Filter by Not started, In progress or Mastered to see what is left.
Fitness / RunningHealth

Log your runs and keep a healthy streak.

How to use
  1. Open Fitness and start a run, or log one.
  2. Hit your daily run goal to earn wallet coins.
  3. Check weekly and total distance on the Fitness leaderboard.
Set your running target in Goal Planner.
Goal PlannerTargets

Set four goals: exam score, study hours per week, running distance per week and syllabus covered. Rings show how close you are.

How to use
  1. Open Goal Planner (Target) from the dashboard.
  2. Type your target in each box. It saves automatically.
  3. Watch the rings fill as you progress.
  4. Tap the calendar icon to see upcoming exams.
The planner tells you how many topics per day you need to finish the syllabus before your next exam.
LeaderboardHow ranking works

Four boards, each with Weekly and Total views.

How to use
  1. Open Leaderboard and pick a tab: Score, Focus, Targets or Fitness.
  2. Switch Weekly or Total at the top.
  3. Score ranks by 80% average exam % plus 20% participation, which is how many of your assigned exams you attempted.
  4. Focus ranks by study hours, Targets by completed weekly tasks, Fitness by distance run.
  5. Tap a student to see their profile and stats.
Skipping exams hurts twice: no marks and lower participation. Even a modest score beats not attempting.
Discus CommunityChat

Class chat to ask doubts, share links and talk with friends and teachers.

How to use
  1. Open Discus and type in the box.
  2. Use the attach button for images or files.
  3. Links you paste appear as tidy preview cards.
Be respectful. Teachers can see the chat.
Notice BoardUpdates

Official notices from your teacher: exam dates, holidays and instructions.

How to use
  1. Open Notices from the dashboard.
  2. Tap a notice to read it in full.
  3. Turn on notifications so you never miss one.
Check the board before every exam day.
Exama WalletCoins

Earn coins for good habits and send them to friends. Protected by a 4-digit PIN. Everyone started again from 0 coins on 06 Oct 2026, and coins are counted fresh from that day.

How to use
  1. Tap the wallet icon on your dashboard and enter your PIN.
  2. Earn: +5 for the daily run goal (+2 extra if exceeded), +5 for a full 4-hour study session (+2 extra if exceeded), +5 for hitting your exam score target, +5 for topping an exam.
  3. Lose: -10 only when absent (no run or no study session that day) and -10 for a failed exam. Falling short while present is not penalised. Sundays have no penalty. An active Immunity also covers absent and failed-exam penalties.
  4. Tap the card to flip it and see the rules and your QR code.
Never share your PIN.
Send CoinsScan & Pay

Pay a friend in seconds, with a Paytm-style sending animation and a success chime.

How to use
  1. In the wallet tap Scan and point the camera at a friend's Exama QR. Or choose From photo, or Enter number.
  2. Type the amount on the keypad.
  3. Tap Pay and enter your PIN.
  4. Watch the coins fly. A green tick and a chime confirm the payment.
  5. You get a Txn ID. The receiver is notified.
If a payment fails, nothing is deducted.
Store & ImmunitySkip safely

Spend wallet coins on Immunity. An active Immunity removes the Absent mark, the -10 coin penalty and the average drop, and shows Immunity in place of Absent or Fail in your sessions, exams, runs and wallet history.

How to use
  1. Open the wallet and tap the store icon at the top right.
  2. Pick a category: Study Session, Exam Skip, Exam Fail or Running.
  3. Partial costs 100 coins (one session or one exam). Full Day costs 300 coins (every session or exam of that day). Running costs 100 coins for one day.
  4. Tap Buy with PIN and enter your wallet PIN. The coins are deducted and the purchase is saved in your wallet history.
  5. Open My Immunities (box icon) on any day and tap the bolt to activate it. Choose the session, exam or date. You can activate for today or up to 6 days ahead.
  6. Tap the gift icon to give an unused or upcoming Immunity to a friend. A gift cannot be undone.
Buy first, decide later. An Immunity only works on the date you activate it for and expires after that day.
Ask Coin & LoansBorrow

Short of coins? Ask a friend. They get a popup and a push notification and can send the coins. It is a loan, so you must return it within the week.

How to use
  1. Open the wallet, tap Scan, then tap Ask coin.
  2. Pick a friend, type the amount, read the return rules and tap I agree, send request.
  3. Your friend sees a popup, enters their wallet PIN and sends the coins.
  4. Tap the hand icon at the top right of the wallet to open Loans. Tap Return to pay back with your PIN.
Return rules
  1. Return the coins within the week (by Sunday).
  2. After the week ends, 1 extra coin is added for every day late.
  3. If you do not return them, the system automatically cuts the coins + extra coins + a 100-coin fine from your account and gives it to the sender. This happens whenever you have coins in your account.
Return early to avoid the extra coins and the 100-coin fine.
SOS EmergencySafety

One tap alerts your teacher and classmates with your live location. Use only in a real emergency. Student accounts only.

How to use
  1. Open the side menu and tap the big red SOS button at the bottom.
  2. A 5-second countdown starts with vibration. Tap Cancel to stop a false alarm.
  3. When it reaches zero, your location, time and phone number are sent.
  4. Everyone gets an alarm pop-up and push notification with a map that follows you.
  5. If sending fails, tap Retry. Keep the app open and location allowed.
Allow location access in your browser or phone settings so SOS can find you.
Profile & SettingsAccount

Manage your photo, password and app preferences.

How to use
  1. Tap your photo on the dashboard to open My Profile.
  2. Open the side menu to change your password or log out.
  3. Allow notifications for exam, notice and wallet alerts.
Use a strong password and log out on shared devices.
